name: Ring of Loose Grip
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of climbing. Instead of aiding the wearer in Climb checks it imparts a -5 penalty. Additionally, any attack roll with a result of a natural 20 causes the wearer to drop their weapon within the 5 foot square he occupies.

Casting remove curse upon the ring allows the wearer to remove it, though the enchantment remains intact. Coating the ring with sovereign glue will destroy it.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of climbing

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
